SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.project_id AS projectId, t.task_type_id AS taskTypeId, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, u.user_name AS assigneeName, t.task_status_id AS taskStatusId, t.priority_code AS priorityCode, t.milestone_id AS milestoneId, t.start_date AS startDate, t.due_date AS dueDate, t.actual_hours AS actualHours, t.progress_rate AS progressRate, t.est_start_date AS estStartDate, t.est_end_date AS estEndDate, t.estimated_hours AS estimatedHours FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT t.*, u.user_name AS assigneeName FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id
SELECT project_id, project_name, parent_project_id FROM projects WHERE status = 'F1'

SELECT curr.PROJECT_ID AS projectId, curr.PROJECT_NAME AS projectName, parent.PROJECT_ID AS parentProjectId, parent.PROJECT_NAME AS parentProjectName, CASE WHEN curr.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL THEN curr.PROJECT_NAME ELSE parent.PROJECT_NAME END AS displayProjectName, CASE WHEN curr.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE curr.PROJECT_NAME END AS displaySubProjectName FROM projects curr LEFT JOIN projects parent ON curr.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = parent.PROJECT_ID WHERE curr.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName FROM users WHERE is_active = 'O1' AND user_type = 'M2'
SELECT task_type_id, type_name FROM task_types WHERE is_active = 'O1'
SELECT task_status_id, status_name FROM task_statuses WHERE is_active = 'O1'
